message.content:
Based on my search, you can download the latest version of Python from the **official Python website**.

## Where to Download Python

The primary and most reliable source is:

**https://www.python.org/downloads/**

This is the official download page maintained by the Python Software Foundation. When you visit this page:

- The website will typically auto-detect your operating system and display a prominent **"Download Python"** button for the latest stable release
- As of the search results, the latest stable version available is **Python 3.14.5**

## Alternative Download Methods

Depending on your operating system, you have several options:

### Windows
- **Microsoft Store**: Install the "Python Install Manager" for automatic updates (recommended for Python 3.14+)
- **Traditional installer**: Download the `.exe` installer directly from python.org/downloads (note: this method is deprecated since Python 3.14 and will be removed in Python 3.16)

### macOS
- Official installer from python.org/downloads
- Homebrew package manager: `brew install python3`

### Linux
- Your distribution's package manager (e.g., `apt`, `dnf`, `pacman`)
- Build from source code downloaded from python.org if you need the absolute latest version

## Important Tips

- Always download from the **official website** to avoid counterfeit or malware-infected versions
- Make sure to check **"Add Python to PATH"** during installation (especially on Windows) for easier command-line access
- You can verify your installation by running `python --version` or `python3 --version` in your terminal/command prompt

Sources:
1. https://www.python.org/
2. https://wiki.python.org/moin/BeginnersGuide/Download
3. https://realpython.com/installing-python/
4. http://geekchamp.com/how-to-download-python-on-windows-11-a-step-by-step-installation-guide
5. http://raspberrytips.com/install-latest-python-raspberry-pi
